verdict.rationale: Ente Auth is an end-to-end encrypted 2FA service with sync and a self-hostable server, so official SDKs are a fair thing to ask about. The evidence pack shows no SDK or client library: the only programmatic surfaces are an export/decrypt CLI, a search deep link (enteauth://search) and an llms.txt file. The probes found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. The CLI is backup tooling, not an SDK to build against, so it does not count here.
